items.name: UMA
items.subtitle: Usage Monitor
items.headline: Know your limits. Keep your flow.
items.description: A native macOS companion for Codex usage, limits, and recent tasks. Built to make the numbers easier to see, right from the menu bar.
items.caption: Public repository demo preview
items.why: How can keeping track of AI usage feel like a natural part of the desktop, instead of another dashboard to manage?
items.focus: Clearer interfaces, useful usage context, and a dependable native Mac experience.
items.invite: Try the public project, share a confusing moment, or bring a fresh product perspective.

items.name: QDigest
items.subtitle: Research, explained
items.headline: Make room for understanding.
items.description: Source-grounded health research, explained in English and Simplified Chinese: concise email briefs with fuller explanations on the web.
items.caption: Format concept · not a live edition
items.why: How can health research become easier to understand while keeping its evidence and uncertainty visible?
items.focus: One source-linked fact package for concise email briefs and fuller bilingual web explanations.
items.invite: I’d like to hear from curious readers, editorial thinkers, and people who care about how information is presented.

zhHans.title: 让作品说话。

items.name: UMA
items.subtitle: Usage Monitor
items.headline: 掌握用量，专注创造。
items.description: 原生 macOS 工具，在菜单栏查看 Codex 用量、额度与近期任务，让使用情况更容易掌握。
items.caption: 公开仓库中的演示预览
items.why: 关注 AI 用量，能否成为桌面体验中自然的一部分，而不用再多管理一个仪表盘？
items.focus: 更清楚的界面、更有用的用量信息，以及可靠的原生 Mac 体验。
items.invite: 试用公开项目，分享让你困惑的地方，或带来新的产品视角。

items.name: QDigest
items.subtitle: 读懂研究
items.kind: 信息工具 · 双语阅读
items.headline: 看见研究，也读懂研究。
items.description: 用英文与简体中文解释有据可查的健康研究：邮件简报用于发现，网页提供更完整的研究解释。
items.caption: 版式概念展示 · 非实时新闻
items.why: 怎样让健康研究更容易理解，同时保留证据与不确定性？
items.focus: 同一份可追溯事实包，生成简洁邮件与完整双语网页解释。
items.invite: 希望听到好奇的读者、关注内容的人，以及对信息呈现有想法的伙伴的反馈。
